## Motivation & Objective

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   Challenges in classification (Tessler et al., 2022; van der Gulik et al., 2023)
-   Machine learning for taxonomy is new, needs evaluation (Alipour et al., 2024)
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
-   Stepping stone: refine models, improve performance
-   Potential: narrow candidate taxa, save time, improve relevance
:::
:::::

**Research Questions**

1.  How accurately can a machine learning model classify animal taxa based on the binary presence of sexually selected traits?
2.  Do evolutionary origin rates of sexual traits provide stronger predictive power than binary trait presence when classifying animal taxa?

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Data Overview (1)

```{python}
import pandas as pd

#file paths
evolution_path = "/Users/matthewthompson/Documents/Academics/DS Masters Academics/Data Mining and Discovery/Assignments/final-project-thompson/data/animals_rateof_evolution.csv"
family_path    = "/Users/matthewthompson/Documents/Academics/DS Masters Academics/Data Mining and Discovery/Assignments/final-project-thompson/data/family_related_data.csv"

#load data here
evolution_df = pd.read_csv(evolution_path)
family_df    = pd.read_csv(family_path)

#shapes
print("Evolution dataset shape:", evolution_df.shape)
print("Family dataset shape:", family_df.shape)

#info
print("\nEvolution dataset info:")
evolution_df.info()

print("\nFamily dataset info:")
family_df.info()

```

-   **Evolution dataset**: 84 rows, 12 columns; continuous rates of origin for 10 sexual traits (float), with tree replicate ID and phylum labels.
-   **Family dataset**: 1087 rows, 13 columns; binary presence (0/1) of 11 sexual traits, with tree labels and phylum categories.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Data Overview (2)

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   **SS** — Any sexually selected trait
-   **A** — Auditory trait
-   **G** — Gustatory trait
-   **O** — Olfactory trait
-   **T** — Tactile trait
-   **V** — Visual trait\
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
-   **C** — Male–male competition trait
-   **F** — Female choice trait
-   **K** — Female–female competition trait
-   **M** — Male choice trait
-   **S** — Intersexual conflict trait\
:::
:::::
